scope: Mini App frontend UI, navigation, cached loading states and API-facing interactions

fixes.changes: Quiet headers, Obsidian foundation colours, reserved badge/counter space, base typography that allows truncation and wrapping.
Stable auth/provider shell, cached tasks/themes/history, geometry-matched skeletons, browser Back controls retained outside Telegram.
Lazy closeable shared drawers, no matchmaking triggered by opening or completing a deposit, single wallet-address save per account/address, ordered transaction ledger.
One level/XP block, shared linked game history, readable full-width rating chart with constant-size markers, real game count label.
Restored theme/achievement destinations, immediate lesson steps, confirmed completion totals, validated puzzle positions, honest empty/error states.
Safe-area login shell, one Telegram app action, retryable widget fallback, responsive referral QR image.
Single deduplicated colour-sync owner; capability checks for colour, close, swipe and haptic methods.

automated_checks.typescript: Passed as part of both builds

visual_review.method: Manual browser DOM and screenshot inspection; combinations sampled, not a complete cross-product suite

limitations: Local browser preview uses mock API and sample identity; no live deposits, withdrawals, paid actions or broadcasts were executed.
Production backend, actual Telegram iOS/Android behavior and field performance metrics were not verified.
Browser e2e/axe suites were not run in this turn; route checks were performed through the browser tool.
Admin-only screens were not exercised because the preview account does not have administrator access.
